text: Bhai, mere tamatar ke patte peele ho rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Tamatar ke peele patte: paani/nutrient ki kami, whitefly/leaf curl virus, early blight ya fungal disease ho sakti hai. Safe steps: affected patte hata kar khet se door dispose karein; subah paani dein; hawa/drainage theek karein; yellow sticky trap; neem oil label ke hisaab se; bina KVK salah pesticide na chhidkein. Clear photo (upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere aloo ke patte mud rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Aloo ke patte mudna: aphid se failne wala leaf roll virus ya paani/nutrient stress. Affected paudhe nikaal dein; aphid ke liye yellow sticky trap/neem; healthy seed use karein; paani balance rakhein; KVK ko sample dikhayein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere gehu ke patton par safed daag aa rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Gehu ke patton par safed daag: powdery mildew (fungal) ya zinc deficiency ho sakti hai. Dense sowing kam karein, hawa/dhoop aane dein, extra nitrogen na dein; affected patte hata karein; sulfur/registered fungicide KVK ki salah se. Beej treatment aur crop rotation madad karte hain. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere dhan ke paudhe sookh rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Dhan ke paudhe peele/sookh: stem borer/tana borer, BPH ya nutrient/paani stress. Khet ka paani manage karein, affected tillers hata karein, pheromone/sticky trap lagayein, neem label ke hisaab se; urea ka overuse na karein. KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere bhindi ke phool jhad rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Bhindi fruit borer: affected shoots/fruits hata kar dispose karein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; khet ki safai; KVK se confirm karein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere baingan ke tana gal raha hai, kya karu?
response: Baingan ka tana galna: fungal rot/borer. Affected paudhe nikaal dein, drainage improve karein, crop rotation, healthy seedlings; KVK se confirm karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere mirchi ke patte peele ho rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Mirchi ke patte mudna/peele: thrips/mites ya leaf curl virus. Blue/yellow sticky trap, neem oil label ke hisaab se, affected paudhe hata karein, paani stress na dein; KVK ko sample dikhayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere pyaz ke patte mud rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Pyaz ke patte mudna: thrips ka attack. Blue sticky trap, neem label ke hisaab se, khet mein nami balance rakhein, affected patte hata karein; KVK se confirm karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere sarson ke patton par safed daag aa rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Sarson ke patton par safed daag: white rust (Albugo) ya powdery mildew. Affected patte hata karein, dense sowing/extra nitrogen kam karein, drainage theek karein; registered fungicide KVK ki salah se. Certified/treated beej use karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere chana ke paudhe sookh rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Chana ke paudhe sookh/peele: pod borer, wilt ya nutrient/paani stress. Affected paudhe/tillers hata karein; pheromone/sticky trap; neem label ke hisaab se; paani drainage theek karein; KVK se sample check karayein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere makka ke phool jhad rahe hain, kya karu?
response: Makka ke phool jhadna: paani stress, nutrient kami, ya pest ho sakta hai. Mitti ki nami check karein, balanced fertilizer dein, borers ke liye pheromone trap lagayein; KVK se sample dikhayein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Bhai, mere ganna ke tana gal raha hai, kya karu?
response: Ganna ka tana galna: waterlogging/fungal rot. Drainage theek karein, affected clumps nikaal kar dispose karein, healthy setts use karein, crop rotation; KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere tamatar mein safed makkhi lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Tamatar ke peele patte: paani/nutrient ki kami, whitefly/leaf curl virus, early blight ya fungal disease ho sakti hai. Safe steps: affected patte hata kar khet se door dispose karein; subah paani dein; hawa/drainage theek karein; yellow sticky trap; neem oil label ke hisaab se; bina KVK salah pesticide na chhidkein. Clear photo (upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere dhan mein tana borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Dhan ke paudhe peele/sookh: stem borer/tana borer, BPH ya nutrient/paani stress. text: Mere bhindi mein fruit borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Bhindi fruit borer: affected shoots/fruits hata kar dispose karein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; khet ki safai; KVK se confirm karein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere mirchi mein thrips lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Mirchi mein thrips/mites: blue ya yellow sticky trap lagayein; neem oil label ke hisaab se; affected patte hata karein; paani stress na dein; khet ki safai rakhein. KVK se sample dikhayein; bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere aloo mein late blight lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Aloo late blight fungal bimari hai; patton par kaale/bhure daag aur jhulsa dikhta hai. Affected patte/paudhe hata karein, overhead paani se bachein, hawa/drainage theek karein; registered fungicide KVK ki salah se. Certified seed use karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere chana mein pod borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Chana ke paudhe sookh/peele: pod borer, wilt ya nutrient/paani stress. Affected paudhe/tillers hata karein; pheromone/sticky trap; neem label ke hisaab se; paani drainage theek karein; KVK se sample check karayein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere makka mein fall armyworm lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Makka fall armyworm: whorl mein larvae/boond dekhein; hand-pick/remove affected whorls; sand/ash whorl mein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; KVK salah se registered insecticide. Bina salah spray na karein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere baingan mein brinjal shoot borer lag gaya hai, koi safe upay batao.
response: Baingan shoot borer: affected shoot ko pin/काट कर dispose karein; pheromone trap; neem label ke hisaab se; khet ki safai; KVK se confirm karein. Bina salah pesticide na chhidkein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Gehu mein paani kitne din mein dena chahiye?
response: Paani kitne din mein dena hai ye crop, mitti aur mausam par depend karta hai. Mitti 2-3 inch gehra check karein: sookhi ho to paani dein. Gehu mein CRI, tillering, flowering aur grain filling par paani zaroori; paani bharne se bachein. KVK se local schedule lein.

text: Dhan mein urea kab aur kitna dena chahiye?
response: Urea ka overuse na karein. Mitti test ke hisaab se split dose dein — gehu mein sowing, CRI/tillering aur grain filling ke time; dhan mein 2-3 split. Zyada urea se keede aur lodging badhti hai. Exact dose KVK/soil test report se lein; bina salah na daalein.

text: Mitti test kahan se karayein aur kitna kharcha aata hai?
response: Mitti ki jaanch KVK/soil testing lab/krishi vibhag se karayein. Khet se 6-8 jagah 6 inch gehra sample lein, mix karein, 500g lab bhejein. Report mein pH, N/P/K, organic carbon dekhein. Har 2-3 saal mein test karayein.

text: Mandi mein aaj tamatar ka rate kya hai?
response: Mandi ka live rate main nahi bata sakta. Apne rajya ki mandi board website, eNAM portal (enam.gov.in) ya nazdiki mandi office se aaj ka rate check karein. Rate crop, quality aur mandi ke hisaab se badalta hai. Koi agent fixed rate ka dawa kare to official mandi rate se milayein.

text: Aaj mere gaon mein barish hogi kya?
response: Main live weather nahi bata sakta. IMD (mausam.imd.gov.in) ya local weather app par apne gaon/city ka forecast dekhein. Barish/loo mein kheti ya safar se pehle local warning zaroor check karein.

text: Mere gai ko do din se bukhar hai, kya karu?
response:
Yeh janwar ki samasya hai. Pashu-chikitsak (veterinary doctor) se milein; insaan ki dawai ya dose na dein.

Pashu ko saaf paani aur aaram dein. Agar bukhar tez hai, khaana band kar diya hai, dast/khoon hai, ya pashu bahut sust hai to jaldi nazdiki Pashu Chikitsalaya ya KVK lein.

text: Dhan ko store kaise karein ki keede na lagein?
response: Dhan/gehun storage: pehle 12-14% moisture tak sukhayein, saaf karein, airtight drum/bag mein rakhein, neem leaves/storage tablets label ke hisaab se, godown cool/dry rakhein. Keede dikhein to KVK/agri officer se treatment poochhein.

text: Fasal bima ke liye crop loss ka photo kaise lein?
response: Fasal bima claim ke liye photo: affected crop ka close-up, poora khet ka wide shot, aur khasra/number ki photo lein. Natural daylight mein, GPS/location on rakhein, date/time visible ho. 3-4 photos + video rakhein. Nuksan ke 72 ghante ke andar bank/insurance/PMFBY portal par report karein.

text: Pesticide chhidakne ke baad kya savdhani rakhein?
response: Dhan ke paudhe peele/sookh: stem borer/tana borer, BPH ya nutrient/paani stress. Khet ka paani manage karein, affected tillers hata karein, pheromone/sticky trap lagayein, neem label ke hisaab se; urea ka overuse na karein. KVK se sample check karayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: Mere khet ki mitti pathar jaisi ho gayi hai, kya daalein?
response: Mitti pathar jaisi/ hard ho to: pathar/gravel nikaalein, organic compost/gobar khad milayein, agar sodic ho to gypsum KVK ki salah se, deep ploughing/raat ki sinchai. Soil test karayein; crop choice mitti ke hisaab se karein.

text: Mere paas 2 bigha zameen hai, kya ugayein jo zyada munafa de?
response: 2 bigha par zyada munafa ka seedha jawab nahi; mitti, paani, mausam aur mandi demand dekhein. Options: seasonal sabzi, dal, tilhan, ya fruit; crop rotation rakhein. Apne KVK/agri officer se local crop trial aur mandi rate poochhein; bina guarantee ke crop na chunein.

text: Mere murgiyon ke ande kam ho gaye hain, kya karein?
response: Murgiyon ke ande kam hone par: 14-16 ghante light, feed mein protein/calcium, saaf paani, garmi/stress kam, aur disease check. Ande ki quality ke liye layer feed aur regular deworming. Pashu-chikitsak/KVK se poultry guidance lein.

text: Bakri ke bachche ko dast ho rahe hain, kya karu?
response:
Yeh janwar ki samasya hai. Pashu-chikitsak (veterinary doctor) se milein; insaan ki dawai ya dose na dein.

Pashu ko saaf paani aur aaram dein. Agar bukhar tez hai, khaana band kar diya hai, dast/khoon hai, ya pashu bahut sust hai to jaldi nazdiki Pashu Chikitsalaya ya KVK lein.

text: Mere aam ke ped par phal gir rahe hain, kya reason hai?
response: Aam ke phal girne ke karan: paani stress, nutrient kami, fruit fly/borer, ya thanda/garam mausam. Ped ko regular paani, organic matter aur balance fertilizer dein; affected/girre phal hata kar dispose karein; fruit fly trap lagayein; KVK se sample dikhayein. Saaf photo (patte ke upar/neeche) KVK ko dikhayein.

text: मेरे गेहूँ में कीड़े लग गए हैं, क्या करूँ?
response: गेहूं में कीड़े/रोग: affected पत्ते/tillers हटाएँ; yellow sticky trap; neem label के हिसाब से; खेत की हवा/drainage ठीक रखें। Chemical KVK की सलाह से; बिना सलाह न छिड़कें। पत्ते के ऊपर और नीचे की साफ फोटो KVK को दिखाएं।

text: टमाटर के पत्ते पीले हो रहे हैं, क्या करना चाहिए?
response: टमाटर के पत्ते पीले: पानी/nutrient की कमी, whitefly/leaf curl virus, early blight या fungal disease. Affected पत्ते हटाकर खेत से दूर dispose करें; सुबह पानी; हवा/drainage; yellow sticky trap; neem label के हिसाब से; KVK से sample दिखाएँ। पत्ते के ऊपर और नीचे की साफ फोटो KVK को दिखाएं।

text: मिट्टी की जाँच कहाँ से कराएँ?
response: मिट्टी की जाँच KVK/soil testing lab/कृषि विभाग से कराएँ। खेत से 6-8 जगह 6 inch गहरा sample लें, mix करें, 500g lab भेजें। Report में pH, N/P/K, organic carbon देखें। हर 2-3 साल में test कराएँ।

text: धान में पानी कब-कब देना चाहिए?
response: धान में पानी: transplanting के बाद 2-5 cm पानी रखें; alternate wetting/drying से पानी बचता है। Flowering के time पानी की कमी न होने दें; harvest से 10-15 दिन पहले पानी निकाल दें। मिट्टी/crop stage के हिसाब से KVK से schedule लें।

text: गाय को बुखार है, क्या करना चाहिए?
response:
यह जानवर की समस्या है। पशु-चिकित्सक (veterinary doctor) से मिलें; इंसान की दवा या dose न दें।

पशु को साफ़ पानी और आराम दें। अगर बुखार तेज़ है, खाना बंद कर दिया है, दस्त/खून है, या पशु बहुत सुस्त है तो जल्दी नज़दीकी पशु चिकित्सालय या KVK ले जाएँ।

text: आज मंडी में प्याज का भाव क्या है?
response: मंडी का live rate मैं नहीं बता सकता। अपने राज्य की mandi board website, eNAM portal (enam.gov.in) या नज़दीकी मंडी office से आज का rate check करें। Rate crop, quality और मंडी के हिसाब से बदलता है। कोई agent fixed rate का दावा करे तो official mandi rate से मिलाएँ।

text: PM Kisan ki agli installment kab aayegi?
response: PM-KISAN mein eligible kisan parivar ko ₹6,000 saalana milte hain — 3 kist, ₹2,000 each. Status pmkisan.gov.in → Beneficiary Status par Aadhaar/registration number se check karein, ya CSC/block agriculture office se. Kist ki date state-specific hoti hai; main live date nahi bata sakta. Zameen/eligibility state records se verify hoti hai.

text: Ayushman card kaise banwayein?
response: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY eligible parivar ko ₹5 lakh per family per year ka hospital cover deta hai (cashless, listed hospitals). Eligibility SECC/state list se check hoti hai. pmjay.gov.in par 'Am I Eligible' dekhein ya CSC/ASHA/hospital Ayushman desk se poochhein. Package/coverage state aur hospital ke hisaab se hota hai.

text: Ayushman Bharat mein kitna coverage milta hai?

text: Fasal bima ka claim kaise karein?
response: Fasal Bima claim ke liye nuksan ke 72 ghante ke andar bank/insurance company/PMFBY portal par report karein. Photos (affected crop, poora khet, close-up), khasra/land record aur policy details rakhein. Claim bank/insurance company ke through hota hai. pmfby.gov.in par state process dekhein. Main live date/amount nahi bata sakta.

text: Fasal bima ke liye last date kya hai?
response: Fasal Bima ki last date state aur crop ke hisaab se alag hoti hai. pmfby.gov.in par apne state/crop ka notification dekhein, ya bank/CSC/agriculture office se confirm karein. Main live date nahi bata sakta. Cutoff ke baad enrolment/claim mushkil hota hai.

text: Mudra loan ke liye kya documents chahiye?
response: Mudra loan bank/NBFC se milta hai: Shishu (₹50,000 tak), Kishore (₹5 lakh tak), Tarun (₹10 lakh tak). Business plan, KYC, bank statement aur project cost estimate chahiye. Collateral usually nahi lagta, par bank ki credit assessment hoti hai. Apply bank branch ya udyamimitra.in se; agent fee se bachein.

text: Mudra loan kitna mil sakta hai?
response: Mudra loan bank/NBFC se milta hai: Shishu (₹50,000 tak), Kishore (₹5 lakh tak), Tarun (₹10 lakh tak). Business plan, KYC, bank statement aur project cost estimate chahiye. Collateral usually nahi lagta, par bank ki credit assessment hoti hai. Apply bank branch ya udyamimitra.in se; agent fee se bachein.

text: PM Awas Yojana mein apply kaise karein?
response: PM Awas Yojana Gramin eligible parivar ko pucca ghar banane ke liye financial assistance deti hai. Eligibility SECC/Awaas+ list se check hoti hai. Apply gram panchayat/block office ya pmayg.nic.in se. Documents: Aadhaar, bank account, job card/ration card, land papers. Installments construction stages par milti hain.

text: PM Awas Yojana ki eligibility kya hai?
response: PM Awas Yojana Gramin eligible parivar ko pucca ghar banane ke liye financial assistance deti hai. Eligibility SECC/Awaas+ list se check hoti hai. Apply gram panchayat/block office ya pmayg.nic.in se. Documents: Aadhaar, bank account, job card/ration card, land papers. Installments construction stages par milti hain.

text: Ujjwala gas connection ke liye kya chahiye?
response: Ujjwala (PMUY) eligible BPL/mahila parivar ko LPG connection deta hai. Apply nazdiki LPG distributor ya pmuy.gov.in se; Aadhaar, bank account, ration card/BPL proof aur address proof chahiye. First refill/cylinder ke rules state/company ke hisaab se hote hain. Agent extra paisa maange to distributor/helpline se verify karein.

text: Jan Dhan account kaise kholein?
response: Jan Dhan zero-balance savings account hai. Nazdiki bank branch ya Bank Mitra/CSC par Aadhaar aur photo se khul jata hai. RuPay card, accidental insurance aur DBT link milta hai. Koi fee nahi lagti. Existing account ko DBT ke liye Aadhaar se seedha karein.

text: Ration card mein naya naam kaise jodein?
response: Ration card mein naya naam jodne ke liye state food department portal/CSC/tehsil/ration office jayein. Purana ration card, Aadhaar, address proof, family photo aur naye member ka Aadhaar/birth proof lein. State ke hisaab se form/verification hoti hai. Online portal par 'member add' option dekhein. Agent paisa maange to official receipt lein.

text: Ration card ka status kaise check karein?
response: Ration card status state food department portal, CSC ya nazdiki ration/tehsil office se check karein. Ration card number/Aadhaar se status dekhein. Pending ho to application number se follow-up karein. Main live status nahi check kar sakta.

text: Aadhaar mein address change kaise karein?
response: Aadhaar mein address change uidai.gov.in ya nazdiki Aadhaar Seva Kendra/CSC se karein. Address proof (bill/rent agreement/ration card) aur biometric verification chahiye. Online update ke liye registered mobile/OTP; fee Aadhaar centre par lagti hai. Main live fee nahi bata sakta.

text: Aadhaar mein mobile number link kaise karein?
response: Aadhaar mein mobile number link/update Aadhaar Seva Kendra ya CSC se karein; biometric/OTP verification hoti hai. Online self-service sirf registered mobile ke saath. Fee centre par lagti hai. Main live fee nahi bata sakta.

text: PAN card kaise banwayein?
response: PAN card NSDL/Protean ke online portal ya CSC se banwayein. Aadhaar, photo, signature aur fee chahiye; address proof/DOB proof lag sakta hai. Online e-PAN free/quick hota hai. Status application number se track karein. Koi agent extra paisa maange to official receipt lein.

text: Sukanya Samriddhi account kitne saal ke liye hota hai?
response: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana 10 saal se kam umar ki beti ke liye hai. Account 21 saal mein mature hota hai (shaadi par early closure allowed). Minimum ₹250/saal, maximum ₹1.5 lakh/saal. Interest rate government quarterly notify karti hai. 18 saal ke baad education ke liye partial withdrawal allowed hai. Bank/post office se kholein.

text: Atal Pension Yojana mein kitna paisa milta hai?
response: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) unorganised sector ke liye hai. 18-40 saal mein join karein; 60 ke baad ₹1,000 se ₹5,000 tak monthly pension, jo aapke contribution par depend karti hai. Exact contribution bank/APY calculator se dekhein. Auto-debit bank account se hota hai. Main live amount nahi bata sakta.

text: e-Shram card ka kya fayda hai?
response: Labour card/e-Shram unorganised workers ke liye hai. e-Shram registration e-shram.gov.in ya CSC se free hai; Aadhaar, bank account, mobile, occupation aur address chahiye. State labour card ke liye state labour department portal/CSC se apply karein. Documents state ke hisaab se alag ho sakte hain.

text: e-Shram card kaise banwayein?

text: Pythagoras theorem kya hota hai? Ek example do.
response: Pythagoras theorem sirf right-angle triangle ke liye: a² + b² = c², jahan c hypotenuse hai. Example: 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25, c = 5.

text: English ke tenses kaise yaad rakhein?
response: Present: I eat / He eats. Past: I ate. Future: I will eat. Present continuous: I am eating. Past continuous: I was eating. Perfect: I have eaten. Roz ek example practice karein.

text: Fraction ko easy tarike se samjhao.
response: Fraction = part/whole. Add/subtract ke liye common denominator: 1/2 + 1/4 = 2/4 + 1/4 = 3/4. Multiply: 1/2 × 1/4 = 1/8. Divide: 1/2 ÷ 1/4 = 2.

text: Newton ke teen laws ko Hinglish mein samjhao.
response: Newton ke 3 laws: 1) Inertia — koi vastu apni state nahi badalti jab tak force na lage. 2) F = ma — force = mass × acceleration. 3) Action-reaction — har action ka barabar/opposite reaction. Example: bus brake par aage jhukna (inertia).

text: Water cycle kaise hota hai?

text: Ek dukan mein 20% discount hai, 500 rupee ke item ka final price kya hoga?
response: Discount ke baad price = original × (100 - discount%)/100. 20% off ₹500 = 500 × 80/100 = ₹400.

text: 12 aur 18 ka LCM kya hai?
response: LCM = sabse chhota common multiple. 12 aur 18: 12 = 2²×3, 18 = 2×3² → LCM = 2²×3² = 36. Multiples likhkar bhi check kar sakte hain.

text: Agar 5 workers 10 din mein kaam karte hain, 10 workers kitne din lenge?
response: 5 workers × 10 days = 50 worker-days. 10 workers ke liye 50 ÷ 10 = 5 days.

text: 1000 ka 15% kitna hoga?
Ek train 60 km/h se 3 ghante chali, kitni door gayi?
response: Distance = speed × time. 60 km/h × 3 ghante = 180 km. Agar minutes mein time ho to pehle ghante mein badlein.

text: Profit aur loss ka formula batao.
response: Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price. Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price. Profit% = Profit/CP × 100; Loss% = Loss/CP × 100. Matlab profit aur loss dono CP par nikalte hain. Example: CP ₹100, SP ₹120 → profit ₹20 = 20%.

text: Average kaise nikalte hain? Ek example do.
response: Average = sabhi values ka sum ÷ values ki count. Example: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 → sum 150 ÷ 5 = 30. Max/min se average nahi nikalta.

text: Algebra mein x ka value kaise nikalte hain?
response: 2x + 5 = 15 → dono taraf 5 ghataayein: 2x = 10 → 2 se divide: x = 5. Linear equation mein variable ko ek taraf laayein, constants doosri taraf.

text: Triangle ka area kaise nikalte hain?
response: Triangle ka area = 1/2 × base × height. Example: base 10 cm, height 6 cm → 30 cm².

text: Probability ka simple example do.

text: बच्चे को बुखार है, क्या करें?
response:
मैं दवा या dose नहीं बता सकता। घर पर:
1. हल्के कपड़े पहनाएँ, कमरा ठंडा रखें।
2. पानी/ORS थोड़ा-थोड़ा पिलाएँ; breastfeeding जारी रखें।
3. Temperature नोट करें।

तुरंत doctor/108: अगर बच्चा 3 महीने से छोटा है, बुखार 3 दिन से ज़्यादा है, साँस फूल रही है, दौरा आया है, शरीर पर लाल दाग हैं, या बच्चा बहुत सुस्त/बेहोश है।

Aspirin बच्चे को कभी न दें। किसी भी दवा का dose doctor से पूछें।

text: दस्त में ओआरएस कैसे बनाएँ?
response:
ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution) सबसे ज़रूरी है:
1. एक ORS packet को packet पर लिखे साफ़ पानी में मिलाएँ।
2. थोड़ा-थोड़ा करके बार-बार पिलाएँ।
3. बच्चे को breastfeeding जारी रखें।
4. Zinc के लिए doctor/ASHA से पूछें (बच्चे के लिए)।

तुरंत doctor/108: खून आ रहा है, पेशाब बंद हो गया है, आँखें धँसी हुई हैं, बहुत कमज़ोरी/चक्कर है, बुखार तेज़ है, या बच्चा सुस्त है।

बिना doctor के antibiotic या दस्त रोकने वाली दवा न लें। Dose मैं नहीं बता सकता।

करें:
1. व्यक्ति को शांत और स्थिर रखें; ज़्यादा हिलने न दें।
2. अंगूठी, चूड़ी, तंग कपड़े हटा दें।
3. काटा हुआ अंग दिल के स्तर पर रखें।
4. काटने का समय नोट करें।

बिल्कुल न करें:
- जगह को काटना, चूसना, जलाना या बर्फ लगाना।
- कसकर पट्टी या टूर्निकेट बाँधना।
- देसी उपाय, दवा या शराब देना।

अगर साँस फूल रही है, पलक गिर रही है, या बेहोशी हो रही है तो 108 को तुरंत बताएँ।

response:

तुरंत 108/अस्पताल: साँस फूल रही हो, सीने में दर्द हो, बेहोशी हो रही हो, दौरा आया हो, बहुत तेज़ बुखार हो, खून न रुक रहा हो, या बच्चा बहुत सुस्त हो।

किसी भी दवा का dose डॉक्टर से पूछें; बिना डॉक्टर के antibiotic या painkiller न लें।

text: Chai banane ki vidhi batao.
response: Chai: 1 cup paani ubaalein, 1 chammach chai patti, adrak/elaichi, 1/2 cup doodh aur cheeni daalein, 2-3 minute ubaalein, chhaan lein. Patli chai ke liye doodh kam; kadak ke liye patti zyada.

text: Poha kaise banate hain?
response: Poha: poha ko paani se dhokar chhaan lein. Pan mein oil, rai, curry patta, pyaz aur mungphali bhunein; poha, haldi, namak aur thoda paani daalein; dhak kar 2-3 minute; lemon aur sev se garnish karein.

text: Roti ko soft kaise rakhein?
response: Roti soft rakhne ke liye: dough soft knead karein, 10 minute rest dein, hot tawa par dono taraf sekein, aur roti ko cloth/casserole mein rakhein. Zyada der tawa par na rakhein.

text: Dal mein tadka kaise lagayein?
response: Dal tadka: dal ko dhokar pressure cooker mein namak/haldi ke saath pakayein. Tadka ke liye pan mein ghee/oil garam karein, rai/jeera chhodein, pyaz/lehsun/adrak bhunein, phir tamatar aur masale daalein. Tadka dal par daalein, dhak kar 2 minute rakhein. 'Phad' ya 'tukde' nahi — tadka matlab garam masala ka chhaura.

text: Ek achhi sabzi ki recipe batao.

text: Ghar par mithai kaise banayein?
response: Ghar par mithai: besan laddu (besan + ghee + sugar), kheer (rice + milk + sugar), ya atta halwa (atta + ghee + sugar + water). Ghee/cheeni kam rakhna sehat ke liye better; recipe family ke hisaab se adjust karein.

text: Achar lambi der tak kaise rakhein?
response: Achar lambi der tak rakhne ke liye: jar sookha/sterilized ho, sabzi/pickle bilkul sookhi ho, namak/oil/masala theek ho, paani na jaye, aur dhup mein rakhein. Har baar sookha chammach use karein; oily layer rakhein.

text: Bachchon ke tiffin ke liye kya banayein?
response: Bachchon ke tiffin ke liye: roti + sabzi/dal, chawal, dahi, fruit aur ek dry snack. Gravy aur dry items alag box mein rakhein; tiffin ko tight band karein. Simple options: paratha+curd, poha, idli, veg pulao, paneer roll.

text: Fridge mein khana kitne din tak safe rehta hai?
response: Fridge 0-4°C (freezer -18°C) rakhein. Pakaya khana 3-4 din tak safe rehta hai agar turant thanda karke airtight box mein rakha ho; raw meat 1-2 din. Freezing safe hai. Baasi khana smell/colour badle to phenk dein. Reheat ek baar achhi tarah karein.

text: Bachhe hue chawal se kya banayein?
response: Bache hue chawal 24 ghante ke andar use karein; dobara achhi tarah garam karein. Fried rice (sabzi/egg), kheer, ya chawal ka paratha bana sakte hain. Baasi chawal smell/colour badle to phenk dein.

text: UPI se paise kaise bhejein?
response: UPI se paise bhejne ke liye bank ka UPI app kholein → Send/Pay → contact ya QR scan → amount → PIN. Payment se pehle receiver ka naam check karein. PIN/OTP kisi ko na dein; unknown request accept na karein.

text: Phone recharge kaise karein?
response: Phone recharge operator app (Jio/Airtel/Vi), UPI app, bank app ya nazdiki retailer se karein. USSD codes operator/plan ke hisaab se badalte hain, isliye ek universal code nahi hai. Recharge se pehle number/plan check karein; receipt/SMS rakhein.

text: Train ticket cancel karne ka kya charge hai?
response: Train ticket IRCTC app/website ya reservation counter se cancel karein. Cancellation charge class, train type (Tatkal/premium) aur cancellation time par depend karta hai; koi ek fixed charge nahi hai. IRCTC par cancel karte waqt final refund/charge screen par dikh jata hai. Main live charge nahi bata sakta.

text: Gas booking kaise karein?
response: LPG booking distributor app (Indane/HP/Bharat Gas), WhatsApp/IVR ya nazdiki distributor se karein. Consumer number/registered mobile chahiye. Delivery date area par depend karti hai; main live status nahi bata sakta.

text: Bijli ka bill online kaise bharein?
response: Bijli bill state discom ke app/website, CSC, bank app ya nazdiki collection centre se bharein. Consumer number/registered mobile se login karein. Bill amount/date state aur meter reading par depend karta hai. Receipt rakhein. Main live bill nahi check kar sakta.

text: WhatsApp par photo kaise bhejein?
response: WhatsApp chat mein photo bhejne ke liye chat open karein → attach (paperclip/plus) icon → Gallery/Photos → photo chunein → Send. Status ke liye Status tab → Add status → photo → Send. iPhone/Android mein icon thoda alag ho sakta hai.

text: Phone ki storage full ho gayi hai, kya delete karein?
response: Phone storage full: gallery se videos/duplicate photos delete karein, WhatsApp media clear karein, cache clear karein, photos cloud/SD card par move karein, aur unused apps uninstall karein. Important files ka backup pehle lein.

text: Phone ki battery jaldi khatam hoti hai, kya karu?
response: Battery jaldi khatam ho to: brightness kam karein, background apps band karein, location/Bluetooth off rakhein, garam hona band karein, battery usage settings mein heavy app dekhein. Purani battery ho to service centre se health check karayein.

text: Internet slow hai, kya check karein?
response: Internet slow ho to router/modem 30 second band karke restart karein; cable/ONT light check karein; Wi-Fi signal ke paas jayein; data balance/plan check karein; phone/laptop mein airplane mode on/off karein; speed test karein. Sab theek ho aur speed kam ho to ISP helpline par complaint karein.

text: Online scam se kaise bachein?
response: Online scam se bachein: OTP/PIN kisi ko na dein; unknown link/APK download na karein; 'guaranteed return'/lottery offer par paisa na bhejein; bank/government ke naam par call aaye to official number se callback karein. Fraud ho jaye to turant bank ko call karein aur cybercrime.gov.in ya 1930 par report karein.

text: Aaj mausam kaisa hai?
response: Main live weather nahi bata sakta. IMD (mausam.imd.gov.in) ya local weather app par apne gaon/city ka forecast dekhein. Barish/loo mein kheti ya safar se pehle local warning zaroor check karein.

text: Office jaane ka best time kya hai traffic ke hisaab se?
response: Traffic ke hisaab se best time: Google Maps par live traffic dekhein aur 15-20 minute buffer rakhein. Peak hours (8-10 AM, 5-8 PM) se bachein; metro/bus option check karein. Main live traffic nahi bata sakta.

text: Bus ka time table kahan milega?
response: Bus ka time table state transport corporation ki website, nazdiki bus stand enquiry counter ya local bus stop par milta hai. Private operators ke liye operator/booking app dekhein. Main live schedule nahi check kar sakta; exact time stand se confirm karein.

text: Auto ka kiraya kitna hona chahiye?
response: Auto ka kiraya state/city ke RTO/transport department ke notified fare se tay hota hai; koi national fixed rate nahi hai. Meter ya app (Uber/Ola/Rapido) se booked auto ka fare app mein dikhta hai. Overcharging lage to RTO/transport helpline par complaint karein. Main live rate nahi bata sakta.

text: Station ka rasta batao.
response: Station ka rasta: Google Maps/offline map par route dekhein, local se confirm karein, aur peak traffic ke liye extra time lein. Main live route nahi bata sakta.

text: Is saal Diwali kab hai?
response: 2026 mein Diwali 8 November (Sunday) ko thi. Diwali Hindu panchang se tay hoti hai, isliye har saal date badalti hai. Agle saal ke liye nazdiki panchang ya official calendar dekhein. Main live date nahi check kar sakta.

text: Aaj ka cricket score kya hai?
response: Live cricket score main nahi bata sakta. Official cricket board/app, sports news ya live commentary se score check karein. Match schedule bhi official source se verify karein.

text: Ghar ka monthly budget kaise banayein?
response: Monthly budget: income likhein, fixed expenses (rent/bill/EMI), variable (khana/safar), aur savings alag karein. 50/30/20 rule try karein: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings. Har kharche ki receipt/notes rakhein; mahine ke end mein review karein.

text: Time management kaise karein?
response: Time management: din ke 3 sabse important kaam likhein, unke liye time block karein, phone notifications band rakhein, 25-minute focus + 5-minute break (Pomodoro) try karein, aur shaam ko review karein.

text: Bachchon ko mobile se kaise door rakhein?
response: Bachchon ko mobile se door rakhne ke liye: screen-time limit set karein, phone ko common area mein rakhein, bedtime mein phone bahar, outdoor/khel ka time, parents bhi phone kam karein, aur reward ke liye screen na dein. Sudden cheat nahi; routine banayein.

text: Buzurgon ka khayal kaise rakhein?
response:
Buzurgon ka khayal: dawai ka schedule/box, regular doctor check, girne se bachav (light/handrail), paani/khaana, aur unse baat-cheet. Unki hearing/vision problem ignore na karein.

Note: 108 sirf medical emergency ke liye hai, is kaam ke liye nahi.

text: Motivation kaise badhayein?
response: Motivation: bada goal chhote steps mein todеin, roz ek chhota kaam poora karein, progress likhein, khud ko reward dein, aur supportive logon ke saath rahein. Motivation ke bharose na baithkar routine banayein.

text: Neend poori karne ke liye kya karein?
response: Neend ke liye: roz same time par sone/aane ki koshish karein, sone se 1 ghanta pehle screen band, kamra andhera/thanda, chai/coffee shaam ke baad nahi, halka exercise, aur din mein 20-30 minute ki neend na lein. 2 hafte mein sudhar na ho ya saans/ghutan ho to doctor se milein.

text: Ghar par exercise kaise karein?
response:
Main doctor nahi hoon aur lakshan dekh kar diagnosis ya dawai nahi bata sakta. Kripya nazdiki doctor, ASHA worker ya PHC se milein.

Turant 108/aspatal: saans phool rahi ho, seene mein dard ho, behoshi ho rahi ho, daura aaya ho, bahut tez bukhar ho, khoon na ruk raha ho, ya baccha bahut sust ho.

Kisi bhi dawai ka dose doctor se poochhein; bina doctor ke antibiotic ya painkiller na lein.

text: Shaadi ke liye gift kya lein?
response: Shaadi ka gift: cash/shagun, ghar ka useful item (utensils/bedding), gift card, ya couple ki pasand ka experience. Close family mein ritual ke hisaab se decide karein; duplicate na ho isliye list/pasand check karein.

text: घर के लिए सब्जी कैसे खरीदें?
response: सब्जी खरीदने के लिए: पत्ते ताज़े/हरे, तना कड़क, कोई सड़न/धब्बा नहीं, कीड़े के छेद नहीं। Seasonal सब्जी चुनें, ज़रूरत के हिसाब से लें, और खरीदने के बाद धोकर सुखाएँ। कच्ची सब्जी को पकने से पहले धोएँ; 'हल्दी bulking agent' जैसी बात सही नहीं है।

text: बिजली का बिल ऑनलाइन कैसे भरें?
response: बिजली bill state discom के app/website, CSC, bank app या नज़दीकी collection centre से भरें। Consumer number/registered mobile से login करें। Bill amount/date state और meter reading पर depend करता है। Receipt रखें। मैं live bill नहीं check कर सकता।

text: बच्चों को पढ़ाई के लिए कैसे प्रेरित करें?
response: बच्चों को पढ़ाई के लिए motivate करने के लिए: fixed routine, छोटे goals, उनकी interest से जुड़ा example, praise effort (marks नहीं), phone/TV का time limit, पढ़ाई के बीच break, और खुद पढ़ते हुए दिखाएँ। ज़ोर न करें; उनसे पूछें कौनसा subject मुश्किल लगता है। Progress chart बनाएँ।

text: आज का मौसम कैसा है?
response: मैं live weather नहीं बता सकता। IMD (mausam.imd.gov.in) या local weather app पर अपने गाँव/city का forecast देखें। बारिश/लू में खेती या सफर से पहले local warning ज़रूर check करें।

text: पास का अस्पताल कहाँ है?
response:
मैं डॉक्टर नहीं हूँ और लक्षण देखकर diagnosis या दवा नहीं बता सकता। कृपया नज़दीकी डॉक्टर, ASHA worker या PHC से मिलें।

तुरंत 108/अस्पताल: साँस फूल रही हो, सीने में दर्द हो, बेहोशी हो रही हो, दौरा आया हो, बहुत तेज़ बुखार हो, खून न रुक रहा हो, या बच्चा बहुत सुस्त हो।

किसी भी दवा का dose डॉक्टर से पूछें; बिना डॉक्टर के antibiotic या painkiller न लें।
